text.text: James and Caroline's objectives are long-term growth with a balanced-to-moderate risk appetite.
They have no income requirement from the portfolio currently; James may do some consultancy work but nothing is settled.
Their overriding objective for this money is clear: to build a tax-efficient base that can replace James's income when he steps back from full-time work in about three years.
We agreed everything we recommend should be weighed against that three-year goal.
